concept: FROM THOUGHT → TO PRODUCT (SKETCHBOOK × PRODUCT STUDIO)
personality: thoughtful, visually curious, artistic, observant, slightly playful, calm, detail-oriented, product-minded, human
context: Marketing / Portfolio Page with Editorial Product Studio Vibe
file_format: .js React components with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion

colors.theme: Light mode by default with warm paper canvas aesthetic

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight font-medium leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight font-medium leading-[1.2]
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-sans tracking-snug font-semibold text-text_primary
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-text_muted
hierarchy.annotation: font-handwritten text-lg sm:text-xl text-signature_accent dark:text-signature_accent leading-snug

textures_and_effects.paper_grain: Subtle noise overlay (SVG background filter or inline noise PNG tile with 3% opacity)
textures_and_effects.borders: 1px solid #E6E2D8 with hand-drawn SVG underline or circle accents for highlight moments
textures_and_effects.radii: rounded-sm for structural cards (2px-4px), rounded-full for pills/buttons, rounded-none for crisp paper spreads

motion.scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling via Lenis. Framer Motion view-triggered stagger for section entrances
motion.hero_transformation: Scroll/timed progression: Thought (floating sketch text/cloud) → Rough Sketch (hand-drawn wireframe) → Structured Wireframe → Polished High-Fi Interface
motion.hover_micro_interactions: Subtle scale-up (1.02), arrow translations (translate-x-1), annotation line draw-in animations, cursor custom ink dot
motion.case_study_slider: Draggable Messy↔Clear comparison slider with smooth motion inertia

mobile_recomposition.node_map: Recomposes from radial node web to vertical interactive story timeline

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out all 14 requested sections with high-level editorial detail, smooth motion, and hand-drawn SVG annotation highlights.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, card, and modal contains appropriate data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use generic blue or purple gradients or dark cyberpunk colors. Strictly follow the warm ivory/off-white background, charcoal text, and signature orange accent.
Use Framer Motion for kinetic transformation in hero, node map spring lines, Messy->Clear draggable slider, and digital garden interactions.
Integrate sonner for feedback notifications (e.g., copying email or submitting contact form).
